mapper.select: SELECT CUSTOMER_ID, CUSTOMER_NAME, NVL(EMAIL, '미등록') AS EMAIL, NVL(PHONE, '미등록') AS PHONE, NVL(ADDRESS, '미등록') AS ADDRESS, DECODE(CUSTOMER_TYPE, 'P', '개인', 'B', '기업', '기타') AS CUSTOMER_TYPE, FN_FORMAT_AMOUNT(CREDIT_LIMIT) AS CREDIT_LIMIT, TO_CHAR(BIRTH_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS BIRTH_DATE, TO_CHAR(REG_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS REG_DATE, STATUS FROM CUSTOMERS WHERE CUSTOMER_ID = #{customerId}

SELECT CUSTOMER_ID, FN_MASK_STRING(CUSTOMER_NAME) AS CUSTOMER_NAME, SUBSTR(NVL(EMAIL, ''), 1, INSTR(NVL(EMAIL, '@'), '@') - 1) AS EMAIL_ID, REPLACE(PHONE, '-', '') AS PHONE, LPAD(TO_CHAR(CUSTOMER_ID), 10, '0') AS CUSTOMER_NO, STATUS FROM CUSTOMERS WHERE 1 = 1
AND UPPER(CUSTOMER_NAME) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%'
AND UPPER(EMAIL) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%'
AND REPLACE(PHONE, '-', '') LIKE '%' || REPLACE(#{keyword}, '-', '') || '%'
AND (UPPER(CUSTOMER_NAME) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(EMAIL) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%')
ORDER BY CUSTOMER_NAME

SELECT C.CUSTOMER_ID, C.CUSTOMER_NAME, C.EMAIL, C.PHONE, C.ADDRESS, DECODE(C.CUSTOMER_TYPE, 'P', '개인고객', 'B', '기업고객') AS CUSTOMER_TYPE_NM, FN_FORMAT_AMOUNT(C.CREDIT_LIMIT) AS CREDIT_LIMIT_FMT, TO_CHAR(C.BIRTH_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS BIRTH_DATE, FN_CALC_AGE(C.BIRTH_DATE) AS AGE, TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, C.REG_DATE)) AS MEMBER_MONTHS, TO_CHAR(C.REG_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS REG_DATE, NVL(C.MEMO, '등급 미산정') AS GRADE_INFO, NVL(ORD.ORDER_CNT, 0) AS ORDER_COUNT, NVL(ORD.TOTAL_AMT, 0) AS TOTAL_PURCHASE, FN_FORMAT_AMOUNT(NVL(ORD.TOTAL_AMT, 0)) AS TOTAL_PURCHASE_FMT FROM CUSTOMERS C LEFT JOIN ( SELECT CUSTOMER_ID, COUNT(*) AS ORDER_CNT, SUM(TOTAL_AMOUNT) AS TOTAL_AMT FROM ORDERS WHERE ORDER_STATUS != 'CANCELLED' GROUP BY CUSTOMER_ID ) ORD ON C.CUSTOMER_ID = ORD.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE C.CUSTOMER_ID = #{customerId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CUSTOMERS ( CUSTOMER_ID, CUSTOMER_NAME, EMAIL, PHONE, ADDRESS, CUSTOMER_TYPE, CREDIT_LIMIT, BIRTH_DATE, REG_DATE, STATUS ) VALUES ( SEQ_CUSTOMER.NEXTVAL, #{customerName}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{address}, NVL(#{customerType}, 'P'), NVL(#{creditLimit}, 0), TO_DATE(#{birthDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), SYSTIMESTAMP, 'ACTIVE' )
mapper.update: UPDATE CUSTOMERS SET CUSTOMER_NAME = #{customerName}, EMAIL = #{email}, PHONE = #{phone}, ADDRESS = #{address}, CREDIT_LIMIT = NVL(#{creditLimit}, CREDIT_LIMIT), BIRTH_DATE = CASE WHEN #{birthDate} IS NOT NULL THEN TO_DATE(#{birthDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ELSE BIRTH_DATE END, UPD_DATE = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE CUSTOMER_ID = #{customerId} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE CUSTOMERS SET STATUS = 'SUSPENDED', MEMO = MEMO || CHR(10) || '[삭제] ' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') || ' 삭제 처리', UPD_DATE = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE CUSTOMER_ID = #{customerId}
mapper.select: SELECT NVL(DECODE(CUSTOMER_TYPE, 'P', '개인', 'B', '기업'), '합계') AS CUSTOMER_TYPE, NVL(STATUS, '소계') AS STATUS, COUNT(*) AS CNT, SUM(NVL(CREDIT_LIMIT, 0)) AS TOTAL_CREDIT FROM CUSTOMERS GROUP BY ROLLUP(DECODE(CUSTOMER_TYPE, 'P', '개인', 'B', '기업'), STATUS)

SELECT C.CUSTOMER_ID, C.CUSTOMER_NAME, COUNT(O.ORDER_ID) AS ORDER_COUNT, FN_FORMAT_AMOUNT(SUM(O.TOTAL_AMOUNT)) AS TOTAL_PURCHASE, LISTAGG(TO_CHAR(O.ORDER_ID), ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY O.ORDER_DATE) AS ORDER_ID_LIST, LISTAGG(TO_CHAR(O.ORDER_DATE, 'MM/DD'), ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY O.ORDER_DATE) AS ORDER_DATE_LIST, MIN(O.ORDER_DATE) AS FIRST_ORDER, MAX(O.ORDER_DATE) AS LAST_ORDER, ROUND(AVG(O.TOTAL_AMOUNT), 2) AS AVG_ORDER_AMT FROM CUSTOMERS C LEFT JOIN ORDERS O ON C.CUSTOMER_ID = O.CUSTOMER_ID AND O.ORDER_STATUS != 'CANCELLED' WHERE C.CUSTOMER_ID = #{customerId} GROUP BY C.CUSTOMER_ID, C.CUSTOMER_NAME
